title: New rules for Ukrainian men in Europe

paragraphs: The European Commission wants to change the rules for Ukrainian refugees.
They plan to continue the special protection program until March 2028. But new Ukrainian men aged 23 to 60 will not get this protection if they must serve in the military.

Kyiv and some EU countries support this plan because Ukraine needs more soldiers to defend the country. This new rule is only for future refugees; men who already have protection in the EU will keep their documents and can stay.

For this plan to start, a large majority of EU countries must vote for it. At the same time, Denmark is making a similar rule, and the EU is also planning a program to help refugees who want to return home.

paragraphs: The European Union has a big new plan for refugees from Ukraine. The EU wants to help these families and protect them until March 2028.

But there is a new rule for men between 23 and 60 years old. If these men must be soldiers in Ukraine, the EU will not give them new protection documents. Ukraine needs more soldiers, so leaders agree with this change. Men who already live in the EU with protection are safe. They can stay. Many EU countries must now vote on this plan. Denmark is also doing the same thing.

words.d: a person who must run away from their home country because it is not safe there
when somebody stays away from a dangerous situation

paragraphs: The European Commission has proposed extending the temporary protection scheme for Ukrainian refugees until March 2028, but with a major change: excluding military-age Ukrainian men.

This new measure, backed by Kyiv and several EU member states, targets men aged 23 to 60 who cannot legally leave Ukraine due to military obligations under martial law. The decision aims to support Ukraine’s defense needs as the country faces serious shortages in its armed forces. However, the rule will not apply retroactively, which means that Ukrainian men who already hold temporary protection status in the EU will not lose it. To become law, the proposal requires approval by a qualified majority of EU countries.

In a similar move, Denmark announced that military-age Ukrainian men will receive residence permits only if they can prove they are legally exempt from military service. Additionally, the Commission proposed a voluntary return program to support refugees who wish to go home.

words.d: leaving someone or something out, or saying that a specific person or group cannot join a program
a strict rule controlled by the army instead of the normal police, used when a country is in a big danger or war
